digest.component_or_area: completion verifier and plan-review close gate
propositions: Completion verifier blocks close when acceptance criteria no longer match reality, with no documented legitimate path forward other than --force-close or --ref to old commits, both of which leave inaccurate ticket state
When acceptance criteria are invalidated by the fix itself, no commit exists where both the fix is present and the original criteria are satisfiable, making --ref escape hatch ineffective
Plan-review close gate's stale-regver check forces full re-review of already-executed plans when criteria registry changes after plan approval, stranding completed work
Auto-generated or unverifiable acceptance criteria cannot be satisfied at any commit ref and have no audited disposition state to mark them as moot or superseded
The correct path for invalidated criteria is to edit the ticket, re-pass plan review against corrected criteria, then close against accurate criteria with full verification
